steps.content: Pylgia reclines a chair in the wheelhouse, and together you carefully lay Shin on it.
Shin's breathing grows peaceful, and before long, she falls into a deep slumber. She's simply too exhausted.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You should tend to your wounds, Pylgia.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Okay.
She sits down on the floor in front of you and unzips her diving suit, revealing horrific wounds that look like something had chewed through her flesh.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: You were right... That monster from before... it might have been following us the whole time.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: The water was unnaturally dark... I couldn't really see it, but I could feel it watching me.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Every time it got close, the static on the radio would spike. So I tried to hunt it down, drive it away, but...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I couldn't defeat it... It had so many... shadows, like tentacles. It took me too long to break free... By the time I made it back, it was already too late.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Even now, I can't be sure if it's gone.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: More likely, it's still following us... waiting for the next chance to strike.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I shouldn't have stayed underwater for so long... No, maybe I shouldn't have left the ship at all. If I'd stayed...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, even if you'd been here, you couldn't have stopped what happened. If anything, you're alive and well. That's the better outcome.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, there's no point dwelling on it now. Shin entrusted the ship to us. What matters most is bringing her back alive—along with the collectors, and… everyone’s legacy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know if the monster is still out there... Maybe we should use some kind of bait to lure it away? No... it's too dangerous to go alone. We can't risk it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're so close to land. If we can just hold on a little longer, we'll be rescued. Shin will also...
Pylgia stares at you in silence. Rather than comforting her, your words are meant more for convincing yourself.
Fog seeps in through the shattered porthole, and you can't stop yourself from shivering.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Are you... cold? There should be medicine and supplies left in the medical bay. Warm blankets too. I'll go get them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm coming with you!
Your overwrought nerves make the words fly out of your mouth. You can't bear the thought of losing someone else.
[Black Screen]
You feel a sudden chill as Pylgia wraps her arms around you.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Don't worry. I'm here.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: You're not alone.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Shin didn't just entrust all this to you alone. I'm here too.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Trust me, it's going to be okay. And I trust you just the same.
[Fade from Black]
She awkwardly reaches out to wipe the dampness from your face.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I never doubted... that you could do this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm sorry... Thank you... Pylgia.
As Pylgia leaves the wheelhouse, you take your place at the helm.
You turn your gaze back to the ocean. Throttling up the engines, you steer the ship into the dense fog.
